title: CoTD-PO: Chain-of-Thought Distillation with Preference Optimization

model.params_source: not stated. The paper gives no decoding parameters for the teacher-model row; AlpacaEval's own model configs would supply them, but which config produced this row is not said.

task.approximation: cannot be fixed: the reported number is a length-controlled win rate produced by the AlpacaEval pipeline, not a per-item score the runner can compute (see open_points)

items.source: tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval (805 AlpacaEval 2.0 instructions); Arena-Hard-Auto (500) and MT-Bench (160) are the other two columns of the same table

fields.label: none - the metric is a pairwise win rate against reference outputs, not a gold answer

items.access_note: HF dataset API returns 200, not gated (checked 2026-09-19)

prompt.verbatim: none. The paper prints no prompt: GPT-4o is scored on the standard public AlpacaEval 2.0 instruction set, and the judge prompt belongs to the AlpacaEval package (weighted_alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo), not to this paper.

output.parse: free text (the model's answer to the instruction)
output.postprocess: the answer is compared with the AlpacaEval reference output by the annotator model, which returns a preference probability; those probabilities feed the length-controlled regression

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: AlpacaEval 2.0 length-controlled win rate (%): a GLM removes the length effect from the annotator's per-instruction preference probabilities against the reference outputs (Dubois et al., 2024)
metric.judge: llm:gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (AlpacaEval's default annotator, 'employing GPT-4-turbo for automated win rate calculation'); prompt location: not in this paper - it is the weighted_alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo template of the alpaca_eval package
metric.original_location: Table 1, row 'GPT-4o (2024-05-13) (teacher-model)', column AlpacaEval 2 (LC) (Arena-Hard 79.2; MT-Bench blank)

cost.est_note: hand estimate: 805 gpt-4o generations (~$10) plus 805 gpt-4-turbo annotator calls over answer pairs (~$16). No prepare run: the metric needs the AlpacaEval pipeline.

open_points: Judge prompt not printed. This study allows an LLM-judged metric only when the judge model is still callable AND its prompt is printed. gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 is callable, but the annotator template lives in the AlpacaEval package and the paper does not say which annotator version was used.

The metric is not a per-item score. The length-controlled win rate is fitted by AlpacaEval's GLM over per-instruction preference probabilities against a fixed set of reference outputs; reproducing it means adopting the AlpacaEval library (generation config, annotator, reference outputs, GLM), which is a decision rather than a runner config.

The row may be quoted rather than measured. 57.5 is also the published AlpacaEval 2.0 leaderboard value for GPT-4o (2024-05-13); the paper does not say whether the teacher was re-run or the leaderboard copied, which changes what a re-execution would test.
No generation parameters: neither temperature, max tokens nor the answer template for the teacher row is stated.
notes: GPT-4o-2024-05-13 appears only as a black-box reference row among the baselines; the paper's own contribution is a distilled student. Both subject and annotator are live snapshots, which is why triage kept it eligible, but the missing judge prompt and the external GLM make it a human decision.
